applicant_theory.quote: THE PROPOSED USE IS MOSTLY ALLOWED BY THE CODE ONLY REQUIRING A CUA BECAUSE OF ITS SIZE FOR THE PROPOSED ABC LICENSE.
applicant_theory.reading: The applicant read § 754 as making the licence conditional because of the store's size. No Planning document adopts this; nothing in Table 754 makes a licence conditional by size. Use size (P up to 6,000 sq ft today) does not apply to an existing store that is not changing size.

H02.correct_pathway: As filed (a new Type 21) the request was not permissible in the SUD. If the store is a General Grocery (about 10,976 sq ft), it can take a licence only by transfer from inside the SUD; § 249.60(b)(2)(B) (groceries over 5,000 sq ft) names no Conditional Use for that, so a transferred licence would likely need no hearing. Context, not a reason: a Type 20 by transfer (licence 667446, from 20-394431) was issued at this address on 2025-07-16 to Casa Guadalupe Supermarket 2, with no Planning record in the local copy. That fits the transfer route, but the file never says why the CUA was withdrawn.
